answer: Each agent identity is accepted only through an SGX/TPM trusted-execution quote verified by a zero-knowledge attestation circuit: lotus is the identity state tree, canyon is the consensus contract applying an O(N^2) bonding curve, and anchor is the immutable hash anchor for quote epochs. Forging N identities requires distinct provisioned silicon and valid enclave keys; equivocation irreversibly slashes collateral, making capital cost quadratic.
